Sources.GitHub.Title: Mod source — GitHub Releases
Sources.GitHub.Description: Enter a public repository and choose a specific release and file. The selected version stays pinned and is never changed automatically.
Sources.GitHub.DemoMode: Example mode / tryb przykładowy — these are sample data and do not link to a downloadable file.
Sources.GitHub.InvalidRepository: Enter owner/repository or a full https://github.com/owner/repository URL.
Sources.GitHub.NotFound: The repository does not exist, is private, or does not expose public releases.
Sources.GitHub.RateLimit: GitHub rate-limited requests (403/429). Responses are cached for 10 minutes — try again later.
Sources.GitHub.RequestFailed: Could not load GitHub releases. Check your connection and try again.
Sources.GitHub.InvalidResponse: GitHub returned an invalid release list.
Sources.GitHub.Offline: Could not connect to GitHub. Check your connection or use the sample data.
Sources.GitHub.NoReleases: This repository has no published releases.
Sources.GitHub.HiddenPrereleases: Only prereleases are available. Turn them on to show these releases.
Sources.GitHub.NoAssets: This release has no attached files. Choose another release.
Sources.GitHub.PinnedNewer: {0} is pinned. A newer release is available; the pinned file was not changed.
Sources.Nexus.Title: Mod source — Nexus Mods
Sources.Nexus.Description: Manual flow: enter the mod page and pinned version, download the archive from Nexus Mods in a browser, and select it here. The archive is not extracted.
Sources.Nexus.Name: Mod name
Sources.Nexus.ArchiveHelp: Supported formats: .zip, .7z, and .rar. The selected file must exist; it is not extracted in this step.
Sources.Nexus.InvalidUrl: Enter a valid, secure HTTPS link to a mod on nexusmods.com.
Sources.Nexus.InvalidArchive: Select an existing .zip, .7z, or .rar archive file.
